title: Legato workflow

executors.description: Start an agent of the workflow on a prompt or a macro, and wait for it to complete the step with the outputs the step declares.
executors.title: Run an agent

executors.description: Send a prompt or a macro to a running agent: the one an earlier step used (agent: {from: <step>}), or a task's own. A prompt reaches it tagged [legato workflow]; a macro is sent as the operator's own words. The step does not wait for the agent unless it says wait_for, or declares outputs (complete).
executors.title: Message an agent

executors.description: Send a prompt or a macro to a task's agent, starting one when the task has none. The step does not wait for the agent. It is read as agent.run with on: <task> and reuse: true that does not wait; new workflows use agent.run or agent.message.
executors.title: Send to the task's agent

executors.description: Stop a task's agent: the one an earlier step used (agent: {from: <step>}), or a task's own (its main slot). With wait_for: [ended], wait for the agent to end first (the operator closes it), then go on.
executors.title: Stop the task's agent

executors.description: Compact a task's running agent with its tool's own compaction, once its turn ends, and wait for the compaction to finish. The step fails when the agent's tool cannot be compacted from Legato, or the agent is still working after 15 minutes.
executors.title: Compact the task's agent

executors.description: Make Legato's copy of a GitHub repository ready for an agent to be cloned from, or pass a directory through when no repository is given.
executors.title: Prepare a checkout

executors.description: Export a task's full context (title, description, notes, pull requests) as text.
executors.title: Read a task's context

executors.description: The task's worktree when it has one, else the fallback.
executors.title: Find a task's directory

executors.description: Add a durable note to a task.
executors.title: Add a note to a task

executors.description: Set values in a task's metadata.
executors.title: Set task metadata

executors.description: Move a task to a column of the board, and its ticket with it.
executors.title: Move a task

executors.description: Fetch a pull request's exact head into a new worktree, and link the workflow task to it. Needs Yggdrasil worktrees.
executors.title: Check out a pull request

executors.description: Review an open pull request (or its stack) in passes posted as GitHub reviews from Legato's reviewer App, until a clean pass approves it. Needs review passes turned on.
executors.title: Review a pull request in passes

executors.description: Close the Burnlite ticket a task was imported from, with a reason and a summary. Needs Legato connected to Burnlite with write access.
executors.title: Close the Burnlite ticket

executors.description: Create a Jira issue or a Burnlite task, with Legato's own Jira settings (jira.base_url, jira.email, jira.api_token) or its Burnlite connection: no agent sees the token. A retry returns the ticket the step already created instead of creating another.
executors.title: Create a ticket

executors.description: Add a Markdown comment to a Jira issue, or a Note to a Burnlite task, with Legato's own settings or connection. A retry does not comment twice.
executors.title: Comment on a ticket

executors.description: Put a Burnlite or Jira ticket on the board as a task, or find the task it already is. An existing task stays in its column; an archived one is restored.
executors.title: Import a ticket

executors.description: List a provider's tickets as data, such as a milestone's frontier or a project's ready milestones, in the provider's order.
executors.title: List tickets

executors.description: List the board's tasks as data, by column, workspace and a condition on each task, in board order. Archived tasks and workflow runs' own tasks are left out.
executors.title: List board tasks

executors.description: Post a message as a Slack or Discord bot set up in Settings › Integrations. Fails at once when the bot is not set up or cannot send.
executors.title: Send a chat message

executors.description: Add a chat bot's emoji reaction to a message. A reaction the bot has already left is fine. The Slack app needs the reactions:write scope; the Discord bot needs Add Reactions and Read Message History.
executors.title: React to a chat message

executors.description: Remove a chat bot's own emoji reaction from a message. A reaction that is not there is fine. Needs the same scope and permissions as adding one.
executors.title: Remove a chat reaction

executors.description: Read the thread a chat message is in, as a Slack or Discord bot set up in Settings › Integrations, for a later step: a Slack thread, a Discord thread, or the replies a Discord message ends. A message in no thread is a thread of one.
executors.title: Read a chat thread

executors.description: Wait until a pull request merges, or closes. Legato reads its state from GitHub when the step starts, after each refresh of a card's pull requests, and every few minutes.
executors.title: Wait for a pull request to merge

executors.description: Run another workflow as a child run, and wait for it to end. The step's outputs are the child's declared outputs, with status and run_id. A child that fails, stops or is cancelled fails the step; a gate in the child keeps it waiting. Retry resumes the same child.
executors.title: Run a workflow

executors.description: Hold the run until the operator chooses one of the options, from a needs-you item or the run page. The step's choice output is the option chosen; Stop ends the run as stopped.
executors.title: Ask the operator

executors.description: Remove the workflow task's Yggdrasil worktree, when it is at the path expected.
executors.title: Remove the worktree

executors.description: Remove one regular file inside a directory; a file that is not there is not an error.
executors.title: Remove a file

executors.description: Remove the saved Chimera session of a task's agent.
executors.title: Remove the Chimera session

executors.description: Ask a task's running agent what it learned, and keep its answer as evidence for Legato Learn. The agent must be running.
executors.title: Ask the agent to reflect

executors.description: Gather a task's evidence and the learnings it may touch into a bounded packet, for a curator agent to read.
executors.title: Prepare a learning packet

executors.description: Check a curator's operations against its packet and keep them as candidates on the Learning page. Nothing is accepted for you.
executors.title: Submit learning proposals
